title: OpenREL Status Vocabulary
description: Describing workflow state - during automated curation and within a published repository.

states.label: Active
states.definition: Loaded from the GitHub policy file, and status is active

states.label: Deprecated
states.definition: Loaded from the GitHub policy file, and status is deprecated

states.label: Pending
states.definition: Loaded from the GitHub policy file, and status is pending - submitted / awaiting merge into GitHub repository

states.label: Rejected
states.definition: Loaded from the GitHub policy file, and status is rejected - kept for reference

states.label: Amendment Needed
states.definition: Loaded from the GitHub policy file, and status is amendment - referred back to creator for corrections
Loaded from the GitHub policy file, and status is 'template' - used to create new policies and licences

states.label: Draft
states.definition: Newly created or copied in automated curation platform, not yet submitted as a pull request to Github
